summary_md: **Shawn Bang ([@wushi123321](https://x.com/wushi123321/status/2115974136128241863))** breaks down Together AI's **Hallmark** (~40.7k stars, MIT), a design skill that lints for AI tells like heading eyebrows, single colored headline words, fake stats and broken mobile layouts: it deals 3 of 50 themes, builds the hero first, then sloplint renders the page at 8 widths for a fresh sub-agent review; needs Node 18+ and Chrome/puppeteer for browser checks ([Nutlope/hallmark](https://github.com/Nutlope/hallmark)).
